name: Kashus Culpepper
summary: Record artwork, tour graphics and *Lil KC*, an original character in development.
description: Kashus Culpepper and Tangerine: record artwork, tour graphics, and Lil KC, an original character in development.
intro: A creative relationship centered on music, character and visual storytelling.
Single and EP artwork, a tour poster, and *Lil KC*: a small, brave boy who charges toward danger while keeping his heart close.
ogAlt: Act I: Summer Nights EP artwork for Kashus Culpepper

chapters.title: Records
chapters.note: Artwork for singles and an EP. Each one links to the release.

artifacts.title: *Act I: Summer Nights*
artifacts.alt: A small boy with a large afro lifts a boombox overhead, with Act I: Summer Nights lettered in an arc and Kashus Culpepper in red script
artifacts.note: EP artwork: a hand-drawn boy, a boombox held high, lettering set around him. [Listen](https://open.spotify.com/album/3RPDh3A283D7F4DuJO95kD)

artifacts.title: *Who Hurt You*
artifacts.alt: Woodcut-style illustration of a boy in a cowboy hat playing guitar at a window, under the line It ain't the man in the looking glass who hurt you

artifacts.title: *After Me?*
artifacts.alt: Woodcut-style illustration of a white country church under oaks, with After Me? in red script across cream paper

artifacts.title: *Out of My Mind*
artifacts.alt: A ring of red birds circling a pale moon on cream paper, Kashus Culpepper set small beneath

artifacts.title: *Jenni*
artifacts.alt: Red printed lips on worn cream paper beneath Kashus Culpepper in red block letters, Jenni signed in script

artifacts.title: *Pour Me Out*
artifacts.alt: Red duotone photograph of Kashus Culpepper in a cowboy hat playing guitar, with Pour Me Out in hand-drawn white letters

artifacts.title: *Howlin' Under the Harvest Moon* tour poster
artifacts.alt: Tour poster with a wolf howling at an orange harvest moon above a list of tour dates and venues
artifacts.note: Tour poster: illustration, lettering and the full run of dates on one sheet.

chapters.title: Lil KC
chapters.note: An original character in development. The master drawing is the reference for every new pose, scene and motion test.

artifacts.title: *Lil KC*, master drawing
artifacts.alt: Lil KC, a small boy with a huge afro and red bandanna, leaps forward in a white gi with a dagger outstretched while holding a red heart close
artifacts.note: He charges toward danger with his dagger out and keeps a small red heart protected behind him. Courage and tenderness in one pose.

artifacts.title: Motion study 001, *The Heart*
artifacts.alt: Lil KC blinks, glances down at the red heart and draws it closer in a short looping animation
artifacts.note: Three seconds at twelve drawings a second: a blink, a glance at the heart, a protective squeeze. A computer-assisted rough measured against the master drawing, not finished animation.
